title: Passcode input
description: Show progress through a one-time code while preserving native paste and autofill.
useCase: Show progress through a one-time code while preserving native paste and autofill.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Only captures a code; it does not authenticate or verify it with a server.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a rounded icon tile, dark heading, grey subtitle, six white rounded digit boxes split three and three, and a text button.
motion: Digits typed or pasted into a hidden input mirror into six boxes; the next box gets a focus ring, and a full code tints all boxes green over 140 ms.
adapt: One transparent `input` with `autoComplete="one-time-code"` and digit-only `onPaste` sits over six `span` slots; `data-current` and `data-complete` drive the CSS states via `transition: border-color 140ms, background 140ms`. Replace the copy and wire `value` to your verification call.
